mapper.insert: INSERT INTO watchlists ( account_id, name, created_on, updated_on ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{name}, COALESCE(#{createdOn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedOn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.select: SELECT w.id, w.account_id, w.name, w.created_on, w.updated_on, COUNT(e.symbol) AS entry_count FROM watchlists w LEFT JOIN watchlist_entries e ON e.watchlist_id = w.id WHERE w.account_id = #{accountId} GROUP BY w.id, w.account_id, w.name, w.created_on, w.updated_on ORDER BY w.created_on DESC, w.id DESC

SELECT w.id, w.account_id, w.name, w.created_on, w.updated_on, COUNT(e.symbol) AS entry_count FROM watchlists w LEFT JOIN watchlist_entries e ON e.watchlist_id = w.id WHERE w.id = #{watchlistId} GROUP BY w.id, w.account_id, w.name, w.created_on, w.updated_on

SELECT w.id, w.account_id, w.name, w.created_on, w.updated_on, COUNT(e.symbol) AS entry_count FROM watchlists w LEFT JOIN watchlist_entries e ON e.watchlist_id = w.id WHERE w.account_id = #{accountId} AND w.id = #{watchlistId} GROUP BY w.id, w.account_id, w.name, w.created_on, w.updated_on
SELECT symbol, name, asset_class, currency, tradable FROM instruments WHERE symbol = #{symbol}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO watchlist_entries ( watchlist_id, symbol, added_on ) VALUES ( #{watchlistId}, #{symbol}, COALESCE(#{addedOn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.select: SELECT watchlist_id, symbol, added_on FROM watchlist_entries WHERE watchlist_id = #{watchlistId} ORDER BY added_on ASC, symbol ASC
